142 days from 1624-02-04:  
1624 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-1752 Gregorian).  
Feb has 29 days → remaining in Feb: 29 - 4 = 25 days.  
142 - 25 = 117 days left.  
March: 31 → 117 - 31 = 86.  
April: 30 → 86 - 30 = 56.  
May: 31 → 56 - 31 = 25.  
June has 30 days → 25 days into June = June 25.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1624-06-25
